description: Real Perseverance Navcam photos with known rover positions, one case per rover pose. Photos and their raw-image records are downloaded into images/ (git-ignored) by data/scripts/fetch_test_photos.py; skyline requests are built by backend/skyline/scripts/build_test_requests.py. The truth map is for scoring only and must never be copied into a /locate request.
